:::{#def-local-maximizer}
#### Local maximizer

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$.
A point $\vx^* \in \reals^p$ is a **local maximizer** of $f$
if there is a number $\tolin > 0$
such that $f(\vx^*) \ge f(\vx)$
for all $\vx$ in the [open ball](vector-calculus.qmd#def-ball) $\ball{\vx^*}{\tolin}$
of radius $\tolin$ around $\vx^*$.

:::
